title: On Reflecting the light back into the room
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：reflect　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reflect 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the painter ① reflected the light back into the room without complaint, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② reflects the light back into the room with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reflect the light back into the room at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reflected the light back into the room before — a line in the catalogue for May 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reflecting the light back into the room without complaint, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reflect on the events of the whole year with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reflect on the events of the whole year at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ reflects on the events of the whole year without complaint every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reflected the light back into the room again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reflect the light back into the room, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody reflects the light back into the room with great care again and somebody must reflect the light back into the room without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 反射（一般过去式 reflected the light back into the room：1965 年画师头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 反射（一般现在 reflects the light back into the room：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 反射（不定式 to reflect the light back into the room：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 反射（过去完成时 had reflected the light back into the room：1959 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 反射（动名词 reflecting the light back into the room 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 深思（reflect on the events of the whole year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去深思把整年的事细细想过）
G. v. 深思（reflect on the events of the whole year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 反射（后段两处：新来的观者照例 reflects on the events of the whole year，而母亲又一次 reflected the light back into the room）

answers.why: reflect 意为“反射”，1965 年画师毫无怨言地反射把光反射回屋里，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reflected。
reflect 意为“反射”，自那以后画师小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reflects。
reflect 意为“反射”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯反射把光反射回屋里”，此处为不定式 to reflect the light back into the room。
reflect 意为“反射”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人反射过，故用过去完成时 had reflected。
reflect 意为“反射”，画师说“反射把光反射回屋里这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reflecting the light back into the room 作主语。
reflect 意为“深思”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去深思把整年的事细细想过”，should ever 之后用原形 reflect on the events of the whole year。
reflect 意为“深思”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻深思把整年的事细细想过（reflect on the events of the whole year at once），以后再也不要提起。
reflect 意为“反射”，新来的观者每个季度都照例深思把整年的事细细想过，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reflects。
reflect 意为“反射”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地反射把光反射回屋里，用一般过去式 reflected 叙述。
reflect 意为“反射”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要反射把光反射回屋里，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，画师毫无怨言地反射把光反射回屋里；画室里每一个观者都说这是头一回。（reflected the light back into the room）
多年以后，画师仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（reflects the light back into the room）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯反射把光反射回屋里这件事本身。（to reflect the light back into the room）
早在 1959 年就有人反射把光反射回屋里，五月那天展品目录上的一行字就是证据。（had reflected the light back into the room）
画师说过，毫无怨言地反射把光反射回屋里这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reflecting the light back into the room 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻深思把整年的事细细想过，以后再也不要提起。（reflect on the events of the whole year，祈使句）
answers: In 1965 the painter reflected the light back into the room without complaint, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three seasons on, the painter still reflects the light back into the room with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to reflect the light back into the room at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had reflected the light back into the room long before 1972, and the line in the catalogue for May proves it.
Reflecting the light back into the room without complaint, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Reflect on the events of the whole year at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reflect 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the painter reflected the light back into the room without complaint, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter reflects the light back into the room with great care whenever the studio asks.
Reflecting the light back into the room without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reflect on the events of the whole year with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio reflects on the events of the whole year without complaint every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reflected the light back into the room again, and the studio remembered that half.
